description: Low-level diagnostic — prefer percher_doctor unless recovery explicitly points here (typically `recovery.nextAction = 'inspect_build_log'` for a known build_failed deploy). Inspects a single deploy: full status, errorMessage, buildLog (when available), and `events` — per-stage timings (queue → build → start → health → swap → canary → done) that localize a slow or failing stage without parsing the build log; empty on servers that predate stage events. Pass `latestFailed: true` to auto-pick the most recent failed deploy on the app (it never covers a deploy that went live but is broken). On success returns { deploy, buildLog, events } with no `recovery` field. The buildLog is the same text the dashboard shows under Deploys → expand row, and is the canonical source of truth for build-time failures.
name: percher_deploys_inspect
